# telnyx_ai_assistant_tag (Resource)

One tag on an AI assistant. Do not also set `tags` on the same `telnyx_ai_assistant`, or the two will undo each other's changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_ai_assistant_tag" "example" {
  assistant_id = telnyx_ai_assistant.example.id
  tag          = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assistant_id` (String) The assistant id.
- `tag` (String) The tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_assistant_tag.example <assistant_id>/<tag>
```
